_meta.method: steps aligned in order by similarity (0.5 words of 'what', 0.3 artefacts, 0.2 systems; pairs under 0.15 left unmatched); agreement = share of the task's time (mean of both runs' step shares) on matched steps with the same rung or block, unmatched steps count as disagreement; mix overlap = sum over rungs (blocks) of the smaller time share; design overlap = word Jaccard of the two design texts, with the chance level from pairs of different tasks; hour-weighted means
